# Mermaid Tiny 12.2.0

Official `@mermaid-js/tiny` browser bundle from the npm registry, MIT licensed.
Copied without modification; the site has no runtime CDN dependency.

- Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mermaid-js/tiny/v/12.2.0
- Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mermaid-js/tiny/-/tiny-12.2.0.tgz
- Verified archive integrity:
  `sha512-9bEE+R974NTh1YJlfc6ztgwhy6+9sE+wAFiFrqvSdtlJHdxGfLytQmHYHNpFKmj94+Z+uMicYrQeGXnTTjILAQ==`
- Files: `package/dist/mermaid.tiny.js` and `package/LICENSE`.

`site/assets/diagrams.js` renders Mermaid code fences after Docsify navigation,
using strict security mode, Dagre layout and system fonts. Tiny supports the
flowcharts and lifecycle sequence diagrams used here; it intentionally omits
some full Mermaid features.
Verify a rendered diagram and navigation after upgrading the pinned runtime.
